brief: Overnight lane gl (CPU-only): build `intarsia bench --emit-record` (benchmark-record v1 lines per measured cell) and tools/composer/gap_to_lane.py (list every cell where IntarsiaML is not the winner or could win a tie, same-quant only, with lane briefs, plus measure-first cells), from the model-benchmarks composer/schema docs. Draft PR unless both checks pass; do not merge.
hypothesis: Records emitted by the engine's own bench, in the shared schema, let the site and composer count IntarsiaML runs without a localeval export; a gap list recomputed against IntarsiaML's own quant gives later lanes a ranked, sourced target list (it should find the Spark 35B prefill gap, vLLM +16.2% at 4k and +15.9% at 16k).

summary: Both tools delivered (PR #112). gap_to_lane finds four same-quant gaps on the live data (Spark 35B concurrent 16x +40.7%, concurrent 4x +40.3%, prefill 4k +16.2%, prefill 16k +15.9%), 5 ties, 36 measure-first cells; --emit-record writes schema-valid records. No engine speed or accuracy number moved, so the verdict is neutral.
lessons: The cell's same_quant_* fields are relative to the winner's quant (on tatooine they compare llama.cpp MXFP4), so a gap list must recompute the margin from contenders[] against IntarsiaML's own quant.
Every gap on the Spark 35B setup carries IntarsiaML quality drop:gsm8k@n1319:0.240<0.281; settle quality before treating the speed gaps as targets.
The two concurrent gaps (+40%) have no catalog technique for IntarsiaML and are probably structural: serve --max-batch is Metal only.
Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B cannot calibrate the bench (its chat template yields a fixed 73-token prompt); Qwen2.5-0.5B serves on the CPU backend and works for smoke runs.

A bench client cannot know the server's version, commit, quant or hardware; the record takes them from /v1/models, /metrics intarsia_info and flags, and leaves the rest Unknown/null (incomplete, kept).
Queueing: endor's quiet gpu,cpu benchmark job (#4284) kept a --load cpu cargo lease waiting about 1h20m; run jobs backfill ahead only after it ends.
